svg.text: WF-018 — CBO writeback error, ABORT, and precise pre-retirement fault
Contract event aliases (not finalized RTL ports)

Example: hart 2 executes CBO.CLEAN at PC 0x8020_1040 with effective address 0x9000_0007. The owner writeback succeeds, LLC memory B returns SLVERR, the CBO remains at the retirement head, and the trap is raised only after every ABORT ACK. The dirty owner state remains recoverable. This is event ordering only: spacing is illustrative, not a cycle or latency contract. True CBO.INVAL has no writeback B-error path. Signal names are contract aliases, not final RTL ports.
